export_evidence: No shipment-level record retrieved. ImportKey page https://importkey.com/countries/india/vamsi-labs-ltd returned only a paywall shell: "Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records of companies all over the world" — 0 rows visible, 0 B/L numbers, 0 dates, 0 destinations. Volza (https://www.volza.com/p/vamsi-labs/), Eximpedia (https://www.eximpedia.app/companies/vamsi-labs-ltd) and Trademo returned HTTP 403; ImportGenius returned a JavaScript challenge. No customs/B-L record with date, destination, HS code or B/L number could be verified.
domestic_evidence: Company website https://www.vamsilabs.com/ states: "VAMSI LABS LTD. an ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 company, is one of the major manufacturers of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API's) in India. The factory is located in the industrial area of Solapur, Maharashtra" and "We have become a popular name for API's in India and abroad in the last 28 years of existence." This is a self-declaration only. No GST turnover band, no GeM/CPPP tender, no contract and no annual-report revenue split was retrieved (Zaubacorp and TheCompanyCheck returned HTTP 403; the site's statutory/annual-report links were not reachable within the call budget).
note: Rule 5 applied strictly: no actual shipment record (export or domestic) was verified, so neither status is 'confirmed'. The only evidence is the company's own website claim of being a Solapur-based API/corticosteroid manufacturer selling 'in India and abroad' — classified as declared, not confirmed. Declared HS codes 292390/292429/293339 (heterocyclic/quaternary ammonium compounds) are broadly consistent with the stated piperidine/piperidone and API-intermediate product lines, but no shipment line was seen to confirm the actual code used, so no HS correction is proposed. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in any source reached. No rejection grounds: the company website is live and presents itself as an operating manufacturer; no liquidation/bankruptcy record was found (registries out of scope for this role). Search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was unavailable during this run, which limited discovery of alternative free trade-data views; recommend a re-check of Volza/Eximpedia free views and the company's 33rd Annual Report 2022-23 PDF for an export/revenue split.
